arg.name: version
arg.description: Specify the Isaac Sim version; leave empty for the latest version.

arg.name: install_path
arg.description: Isaac Sim installation root; overrides version when set.

arg.name: use_internal_libs
arg.description: Use the ROS libraries shipped with Isaac Sim.

arg.name: dds_type
arg.description: Override the RMW implementation with fastdds, cyclonedds, or zenoh.

arg.name: gui
arg.description: USD file to open in standard GUI mode.

arg.name: standalone
arg.description: Python file to run in the standalone workflow.

arg.name: python_script
arg.description: Python script to execute after GUI-mode startup.

arg.name: play_sim_on_start
arg.description: Play a GUI-loaded scene after startup.

arg.name: ros_distro
arg.description: ROS distribution to use (Humble or Jazzy).

arg.name: ros_installation_path
arg.description: Comma-separated ROS setup files for non-default installations.

arg.name: headless
arg.description: Headless mode: native, webrtc, or empty for GUI.

arg.name: custom_args
arg.description: Additional arguments forwarded to Isaac Sim.

arg.name: exclude_install_path
arg.description: Comma-separated paths excluded from process environment variables.
